7.0 OBJECTIVE ELEMENTS

7.1 There is a documented policy and procedure for Pediatric services.

7.2 The organization defines and displays the scope of its pediatric services.

7.3 Provisions are made for special care of children.

7.4 Patient assessment includes detailed nutritional, growth and psychosocial assessment.

7.5 Documented policies and procedures prevent child abduction and abuse.

8.0 PROCESSES

8.1 Hospital is following assessment of Pediatric patients, care plan and addressing special needs, guidelines available for the case of Pediatric.

8.1.1 General Instructions: Recognition of the seriously ill or injured child involves the identification of a number of key signs affecting the child’s airway, breathing, circulatory or neurological systems. If these signs are present, the child must be regarded as critical. Then the staff will follow the assessment, diagnosis and treatment regimens as per procedures:

1) Medical Emergencies in Children

2) Trauma Emergencies in Children

3) Anaphylaxis and Allergic reactions in Children

4) Asthma in Children

5) Convulsions in Children

6) Hyperbilirubinemia & Glycaemia Emergencies in Children

7) Overdose and Poisoning in Children

8) Child Basic/advanced Life Support

9) Foreign Body Airway Obstruction

10) Dealing with the Death of Children including sudden infant death syndrome

8.2 The services are displayed in the Lobby and near the Pediatrics OPD.

8.3 Patient assessment includes detailed nutritional, growth and psychosocial assessment.

8.4 The hospital ensures that there is adequate security/surveillance like security guards, CCTV cameras and trained staff. to prevent child abduction and abuse.
